outcome: LATCH score at 1 hour and 24 hours
serum prolactin level at 1 hour and 24 hours
cohort: 120 women who underwent caesarean delivery and 120 women who underwent vaginal delivery
finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with lower LATCH scores and serum prolactin levels in the early postpartum period compared to vaginal delivery, suggesting a negative impact on early breastfeeding initiation.
mod_finding: Mothers delivered by caesarean section had more difficulty with latch and hold of the baby compared to those who delivered vaginally.
